title: V2 Player
noAudio: Audio is unavailable in this browser
profTagline: A player for Farbrausch V2 (.v2m) chiptunes — the demoscene synth that packs whole songs into a few kilobytes. The V2 synthesizer runs live in the browser as a hand-built WebAssembly module rendering PCM on an AudioWorklet: open any .v2m or .v2mz file, keep a small library, play in the background with lock-screen controls. Offline.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
